subject: Confused interpreting a regression result, is it possible to contain Categorical covariates in a regression model which use INLA-SPDE to control spatial effects

messages.author: e9ab831d77228443
messages.subject: Confused interpreting a regression result, is it possible to contain Categorical covariates in a regression model which use INLA-SPDE to control spatial effects
parts:
Dear all,

I have used the INLA-SPDE to control the spatial effects in a regression on housing data. 
However, several covariates are categorical variables.  
When I try to interpret the results of the regression, I find that the results just show a coefficient of the corresponding categorical variable. On the contrary, some categorical variable (polytomous variable) owns more than two levels, how can I interpret these categorical variables using one coefficient?

I upload my R file and dataset file in the attachment

Best wishes
Charles
